ops.title: Prove native HTTP header whole-wall deadline behavior after the core caller fix
ops.description: Owner: /root/long_running_watch_flakes_ship. Root explicitly deferred artificially dribbling response-header whole-wall semantics as a rare follow-up while ordinary blocked/no-header60s timeout and read1 remaining-budget behavior ship with core CCI native caller. Current native client uses configured socket timeout before header parsing and monotonic remaining checks across normal phases/body read1; getresponse internal header reads can reset per-I/O timeout on artificial dribbling. No claim of exact total-wall deadline until proved. Next: CI-only controlled fragmented-header case against the actual supported producer/stdlib client; determine whether a bounded correction is needed without new timer/thread framework, or exonerate impossible supported-producer behavior. No local tests/builds/benchmarks, live forced work, signals or user-facing timeout change. Evidence FE/landing-cci-native-query-delivery.json and root explicit core-first disposition.

ops.text: CI source-backed fragmented-header evidence distinguishes configured socket/ordinary-read budget from actual total-wall behavior; supported-producer limits are explicit.

If actionable, root accepts a bounded no-new-thread/timer design and it passes independent review/CI then normal merge/release/serialized installed verification; otherwise close with source/CI exoneration.
